2609.31342.title: Stale-Document Poisoning: When Outdated Retrieval Overrides Correct Model Answers
2609.31342.paper_summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is often used to address outdated knowledge by providing external evidence. But retrieval helps only when that evidence is still valid. We identify a temporal alignment failure, stale-document poisoning, in which outdated evidence makes a model wrong despite answering correctly without retrieval. We construct a benchmark of 317 verified knowledge reversals across medicine, law, software, and platform policy, grounded in dated official sources. Across 12 models, recent medical reversals are harder than long-established ones. More importantly, outdated retrieval flips 30% of Llama and 37% of Qwen answers even without instructions to trust the document; explicit follow instructions raise these rates to 66% and 75%. Across four open models and four domains, poisoning ranges from 17-91%, while matched up-to-date evidence is followed in 97-100% of trials. To isolate temporal applicability, we keep the historical evidence unchanged across 50 reversals and vary only the evaluation date. A clear pattern emerges: dates alone produce only modest adaptation, but when models are explicitly told when the old evidence stops applying, the larger models switch to the appropriate answer almost perfectly. Causal interventions confirm that this validity information directly shapes the final decision. The same internal components also support broader comparison tasks, suggesting that temporal applicability can recruit a general reasoning mechanism used for other comparisons. Finally, a fixed recency-aware hybrid re-ranker reduces poisoning by 4.6-10.0 points when dates are accurate, with gains that depend on reliable temporal metadata. Reliable RAG therefore requires selective trust: models must determine not only what retrieved evidence says, but whether it still applies.
2609.31342.paper_summary_zh: 檢索增強生成（RAG）通常用於通過提供外部證據來解決過時的知識。但檢索僅在該證據仍然有效時才有幫助。我們識別出一種時間對齊失敗，即過時文檔中毒，其中過時的證據使模型錯誤，儘管在沒有檢索的情況下回答正確。我們構建了一個基準，涵蓋317個經過驗證的知識反轉，涉及醫學、法律、軟體和平台政策，基於過時的官方來源。在12個模型中，近期的醫學反轉比長期建立的反轉更難。更重要的是，即使在沒有指示信任文檔的情況下，過時的檢索也會翻轉30%的Llama和37%的Qwen答案；明確的遵循指示將這些比率提高到66%和75%。在四個開放模型和四個領域中，中毒範圍從17%到91%，而匹配的最新證據在97%到100%的試驗中被遵循。為了隔離時間適用性，我們在50個反轉中保持歷史證據不變，僅變更評估日期。一個明顯的模式出現：僅僅依賴日期會產生有限的適應，但當模型被明確告知舊證據何時不再適用時，較大的模型幾乎完美地切換到適當的答案。因果干預確認這一有效性信息直接影響最終決策。同樣的內部組件也支持更廣泛的比較任務，這表明時間適用性可以招募用於其他比較的一般推理機制。最後，當日期準確時，一個固定的近期感知混合重排序器將中毒降低4.6-10.0點，增益取決於可靠的時間元數據。因此，可靠的RAG需要選擇性信任：模型必須確定不僅檢索證據所說的內容，還要確定它是否仍然適用。
